name: Timeline Block
description: A configurable block plugin that renders editor-entered events as a chronological timeline in one of 10 CSS layouts.
project_description: Timeline Block provides a single custom block plugin (id `timeline_block`, admin label "Timeline Block") that lets an editor build a timeline entirely inside the block configuration form and render it as a chronological sequence of events. Each timeline item has a plain-text Title, a plain-text Time/phase label, a rich-text Description (a `text_format` element, default `basic_html`), and a numeric weight (1-120) used to sort the items. A block-wide rich-text Timeline header and a layout selector (Layout 1 through Layout 10) complete the form. Items are added and removed with AJAX buttons; on save the whole set is serialised to JSON and stored as three block-config keys (`timeline_data`, `timeline_header`, `timeline_layout`). The block renders via the `timeline_block` theme hook and the bundled `templates/timeline-block.html.twig`, which contains all 10 layout markups selected by the stored `timeline_layout` value; a single theme-level CSS library (`css/timeline.css`) styles them. There is no JavaScript and no external/CDN library. The module also manages CKEditor-embedded images inside the header and item descriptions: `hook_form_alter` on the block delete form plus `blockSubmit` load the referenced File entities, mark them permanent, register file usage under the `editor`/`file` provider, and mark newly-orphaned files temporary. It softly depends on core `file`, `editor` and `filter` (uses `\Drupal\file\Entity\File`, `_editor_parse_file_uuids`, and `#type => text_format`) although the info file only declares a dependency on core `block`. 10 predefined pure-CSS layouts, manual weight sorting, and template/CSS override are the extent of the feature set. Maintained by Sujan Shrestha.
